sentences.7.4 Går denne bussen til Førde?: 7.4 Does this bus go to Førde?
Marit is at the bus station.
She is going to visit a friend in Førde.
sentences.Hun vil ta buss, for det er langt å kjør: She wants to take the bus, because it's a long way to drive alone.
sentences.Hei! Går denne bussen til Førde?: Hi! Does this bus go to Førde?
sentences.Så fint! Hvor lang tid tar turen?: Great! How long does the journey take?
sentences.Det tar cirka fem og en halv time dit. S: It takes about five and a half hours to get there. Shall I help you with your luggage?
Yes, please! I have quite a lot of luggage.
sentences.Å! Har du alle disse veskene? Hvor mange: Oh! Are all these bags yours? How many weeks are you going to be away?
I'm going to be there for five days.
sentences.Ja vel. Har du billett?: I see. Do you have a ticket?
Yes, I have it on my mobile. Look here.
sentences.Fint. Takk skal du ha. God tur!: Good. Thank you. Have a good trip!
sentences.Det er mange passasjerer på bussen, og M: There are lots of passengers on the bus, and Marit tries to find a free seat.
sentences.Ei ung jente sitter alene, men hun har e: A young girl is sitting alone, but she has a rucksack on the seat next to her.
sentences.Alle setene er opptatt av folk eller bag: All the seats are taken by people or luggage.
sentences.Hun stopper ved siden av en gutt og spør: She stops next to a young man and asks him.
sentences.Han har også en sekk på setet ved siden: He also has a rucksack on the seat next to him.
sentences.Unnskyld, er det ledig her?: Excuse me, is this seat free?
sentences.Ja, vær så god. Dette setet er ledig. Du: Yes, go ahead. This seat is free. You can sit here. I'll just move my rucksack.
Marit sits down, and the bus drives off.
sentences.Hun tar opp ei bok og er klar for mange: She takes out a book and is ready for many hours on the bus.
She takes the bus to work every day.
We have to order a taxi.
In Oslo we can take the metro.
You can take the car on the ferry.
They cycle to school and to work.
